hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right is extremely narrow, likely under 4 feet, which restricts accessibility and comfort.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the row houses

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway
hazards.description: The effective walking width is significantly constrained by building stoops and parked vehicles, making it difficult for pedestrians to pass each other.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right side of the street in front of the red and grey houses.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: High-profile parked vehicles block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Blue SUV parked along the curb.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right side of the image is severely cracked and uneven, creating a significant trip hazard.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks, forcing pedestrians to cross an unmarked, wide roadway without designated space.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Degraded Walkway Surface
hazards.description: The paved area for pedestrians is heavily cracked, uneven, and crumbling, posing a significant trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, left of the red vehicle

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Lighting
hazards.description: No street lights are visible, which would make this area unsafe for pedestrians at night.

hazards.name: Protruding steps
hazards.description: Steps from the row houses extend into the sidewalk, narrowing the effective walking path and creating potential trip hazards or accessibility barriers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk in front of the residential buildings.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vans and cars block the line of sight between pedestrians (especially children) and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbside along the length of the block.

hazards.name: Absence of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with vehicles due to the complete lack of sidewalks or protected paths.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and midground along the building frontage.

hazards.name: Surface Hazards
hazards.description: Cracked pavement and loose debris create significant trip hazards for anyone walking through the area.

hazards.name: Lack of Lighting
hazards.description: No street lighting is visible, making the area unsafe for pedestrians after dark.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: Pedestrians on the left sidewalk are directly adjacent to moving traffic with no physical or vertical separation.

hazards.name: Wide Uninterrupted Travel Lanes
hazards.description: The wide, straight roadway design without traffic calming measures likely encourages higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Narrow Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Entry stairs from the row houses and utility poles significantly reduce the usable width of the sidewalk, potentially forcing pedestrians into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk in front of the houses and at the utility pole on the right.

hazards.name: Debris and trash obstruction
hazards.description: Significant amounts of trash, scrap metal, and fencing materials are spilling from the adjacent property onto the pedestrian walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center foreground along the fence line

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: The walkway surface is severely cracked, uneven, and crumbling, creating significant trip hazards.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection of the two streets

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian signal heads are visible, meaning walkers have no clear indication of when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Attached to the traffic light mast arms

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Lanes
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide asphalt surface encourages higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway surface in the foreground

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The long stretch of fencing and vacant land on the right reduces natural surveillance and 'eyes on the street'.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A pile of tires and debris is located directly in the center of the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation

interventions.title: Curb Extensions and Marked Crosswalks

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Plant street trees on both sides to provide shade and create a psychological narrowing effect to slow traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Road Diet

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction

interventions.title: Curb and Buffer Zone

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
